basic_details.job_title: JNCASR Secretarial Support Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR), Jakkur, Bengaluru, has invited applications for 1 temporary Secretarial Support post (Advt. No. MML/08) in a sponsored project under Prof. Kaustuv Sanyal, MBGU Unit. Applications are sent by email to [email protected] latest by 3 December 2026; the notice does not say whether this date is for receipt or dispatch. The remuneration is Rs.11000 consolidated per month.

qualification.details: Essential qualification: a degree / PG Diploma in any discipline with relevant experience in project handling, administration or office management. Candidates should possess good organizational and documentation skills, along with basic computer proficiency. Desirable: candidates with experience in handling research projects and project administration, as well as in maintaining project expenditure records and laboratory inventory, will be preferred. Age limit: maximum age limit 40 years. The notice prints no "as on" date for age and no age relaxation. Those in employment or pursuing Ph.D. must submit a No Objection Certificate from the employer or Ph.D. Supervisor. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

selection_process: Shortlisted candidates may be invited for an online interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview in person.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application by email to Prof. Kaustuv Sanyal, MBGU Unit, at [email protected] , latest by 3rd December 2026. The notice does not give an email subject line or a postal address for applications. Get the Template from the JNCASR website (the notice says it is available there) and fill it in duly. Scan the duly filled Template. Prepare copies of the original testimonials in support of educational qualification, age, experience, etc, and a brief resume. Give your Skype ID, email address and mobile number. Email the scanned Template, the testimonial copies and the resume to [email protected] latest by 3rd December 2026.

faq.question: Q1. How many Secretarial Support posts has JNCASR announced?
faq.answer: JNCASR has announced 1 temporary Secretarial Support post under Advt. No. MML/08, in a sponsored project at the MBGU Unit, Jakkur, Bengaluru.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for JNCASR Secretarial Support?
faq.answer: The application must be sent by email latest by 3rd December 2026. The notice does not say whether the date is for receipt or dispatch.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for JNCASR Secretarial Support?
faq.answer: A degree / PG Diploma in any discipline with relevant experience in project handling, administration or office management. Good organizational and documentation skills and basic computer proficiency are also needed.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years. The notice prints no age relaxation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this post?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs.11000 consolidated per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email the scanned, duly filled Template, copies of testimonials and a brief resume to Prof. Kaustuv Sanyal, MBGU Unit, at [email protected] latest by 3rd December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates may be invited for an online interview. The notice does not describe any other stage.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notice invites applications for a temporary position sanctioned in a sponsored project.

faq.question: Q9. Is a No Objection Certificate required?
faq.answer: Yes, for those in employment or pursuing Ph.D. They must submit a No Objection Certificate from the employer or Ph.D. Supervisor.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview in person.
